Title: Home Page — Layout, Sections, and Styling System
Summary: Authoritative reference for the index.html home page structure, CSS design system, and JavaScript behavior. Covers the header, hero, services, about, work, contact, and footer sections, plus the mobile navigation and responsive grid patterns.
Content:
## Overview

The home page (`index.html`) is a single-page marketing layout with six major sections: Header, Hero, Services, About, Work, Contact, and Footer. It uses a shared CSS design system in `css/styles.css` and lightweight vanilla JS in `js/main.js`.

## HTML Structure

- `<header class="site-header">` — sticky header with logo, desktop nav, and mobile hamburger toggle.
- `<section class="hero">` — centered headline, subtitle, and two CTA buttons.
- `<section id="services" class="services">` — three service cards in a responsive grid.
- `<section id="about" class="about">` — two-column text + visual placeholder.
- `<section id="work" class="work">` — three project cards in a responsive grid.
- `<section id="contact" class="contact">` — two-column info + contact form.
- `<footer class="site-footer">` — brand, copyright year, and footer nav.

All sections use `aria-labelledby` for accessibility and semantic HTML5 landmarks.

## CSS Design System

### Custom Properties (`:root`)
- `--color-bg`: `#ffffff`
- `--color-surface`: `#f8f9fa`
- `--color-surface-alt`: `#eef1f4`
- `--color-text`: `#1a1a2e`
- `--color-text-secondary`: `#5a5a6e`
- `--color-accent`: `#2563eb`
- `--color-accent-hover`: `#1d4ed8`
- `--color-accent-light`: `#eff6ff`
- `--color-border`: `#e2e8f0`
- `--color-footer-bg`: `#0f172a`
- `--color-footer-text`: `#94a3b8`
- `--font-body`: system-ui stack
- `--radius-sm/md/lg`: `0.5rem / 0.75rem / 1rem`
- `--shadow-sm/md/lg`: layered soft shadows
- `--transition-fast/base`: `150ms / 250ms ease`

### Layout
- `.container`: `max-width: 1200px`, fluid padding via `clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2rem)`.

### Responsive Breakpoints
- `640px`: 2-column grids for services and work.
- `768px`: desktop nav visible, hamburger hidden; 2-column about and contact.
- `1024px`: 3-column grids for services and work.

### Components
- `.btn`: shared button base with `.btn-primary` (accent fill) and `.btn-secondary` (outline).
- `.service-card`, `.work-card`: hover lift with `translateY(-4px)` and `box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg)`.
- `.contact-form`: white card on surface background with focus ring using accent color.

### Mobile Navigation
- `.main-nav` is `display: none` by default.
- `.main-nav.is-open` becomes `display: block` as an absolute dropdown below the header.
- `.nav-toggle` hamburger animates to an X when `aria-expanded="true"`.

## JavaScript Behavior (`js/main.js`)

- **Footer year**: sets `#year` to `new Date().getFullYear()`.
- **Mobile toggle**: click on `.nav-toggle` toggles `aria-expanded` and `.is-open` on `.main-nav`.
- **Auto-close**: clicking any `.nav-list a` closes the mobile menu if open.

## Accessibility
- Semantic landmarks: `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<footer>`.
- `aria-label` on navs and form.
- `aria-expanded` on hamburger toggle.
- `focus-visible` outline using accent color.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables smooth scroll and transitions.

## Asset References
- `css/styles.css` — external stylesheet.
- `js/main.js` — external script.
- No external images; placeholders use inline SVGs and CSS gradients.
